mapper.insert: /* ProductMapper.saveProduct */ INSERT INTO PRODUCT (USR_SN, CAT_SN, PRD_NM, PRD_CN, PRD_STATUS_CD, PRD_START_AMT, PRD_IBY_AMT, PRD_TRD_METHOD_CD, PRD_USE_YN, PRD_REG_ID, PRD_UPDT_ID, PRD_DRAFT_BID_UNIT, PRD_DRAFT_START_DT, PRD_DRAFT_END_DT, PRD_DRAFT_START_NOW_YN, PRD_DRAFT_POLICY_AGREED_YN) VALUES (#{usrSn}, #{catSn}, #{prdNm}, #{prdCn}, #{prdStatusCd}, #{prdStartAmt}, #{prdIbyAmt}, #{prdTrdMethodCd}, 'Y', #{prdRegId}, #{prdUpdtId}, #{prdDraftBidUnit}, #{prdDraftStartDt}, #{prdDraftEndDt}, #{prdDraftStartNowYn}, #{prdDraftPolicyAgreedYn})
mapper.select: /* ProductMapper.findProductById */ SELECT p.PRD_SN, p.USR_SN, p.CAT_SN, c.CAT_NM, p.PRD_NM, p.PRD_CN, p.PRD_STATUS_CD, p.PRD_START_AMT, p.PRD_IBY_AMT, p.PRD_TRD_METHOD_CD, p.PRD_REG_DT, p.PRD_UPDT_DT, p.PRD_DRAFT_BID_UNIT, p.PRD_DRAFT_START_DT, p.PRD_DRAFT_END_DT, p.PRD_DRAFT_START_NOW_YN, p.PRD_DRAFT_POLICY_AGREED_YN, f.FL_PATH AS PRD_IMG_URL FROM PRODUCT p JOIN CATEGORY c ON c.CAT_SN = p.CAT_SN LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_IMAGE pi ON pi.PRD_SN = p.PRD_SN AND pi.PRD_IMG_RPRS_YN = 'Y' LEFT JOIN FILES f ON f.FL_SN = pi.FL_SN WHERE p.PRD_SN = #{prdSn} AND p.PRD_USE_YN = 'Y' AND p.PRD_STATUS_CD != 'PRDC0004'

/* ProductMapper.findMyProducts */ SELECT p.PRD_SN, p.USR_SN, p.CAT_SN, c.CAT_NM, p.PRD_NM, p.PRD_CN, p.PRD_STATUS_CD, p.PRD_START_AMT, p.PRD_IBY_AMT, p.PRD_TRD_METHOD_CD, p.PRD_REG_DT, p.PRD_UPDT_DT, f.FL_PATH AS PRD_IMG_URL FROM PRODUCT p JOIN CATEGORY c ON c.CAT_SN = p.CAT_SN LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_IMAGE pi ON pi.PRD_SN = p.PRD_SN AND pi.PRD_IMG_RPRS_YN = 'Y' LEFT JOIN FILES f ON f.FL_SN = pi.FL_SN LEFT JOIN AUCTION a ON a.PRD_SN = p.PRD_SN LEFT JOIN TRADE t ON t.PRD_SN = p.PRD_SN AND t.TRD_TYPE_CD = 'TRDC0001' WHERE p.USR_SN = #{usrSn} AND p.PRD_USE_YN = 'Y' AND p.PRD_STATUS_CD != 'PRDC0004'
AND p.PRD_STATUS_CD = 'PRDC0001'
AND p.PRD_STATUS_CD = 'PRDC0002' AND a.AUC_STATUS_CD IN ('AUCC0001', 'AUCC0002')
AND a.AUC_STATUS_CD = 'AUCC0003' AND t.TRD_SN IS NULL
AND t.TRD_STATUS_CD IN ('TRDC0003', 'TRDC0004', 'TRDC0005')
AND t.TRD_STATUS_CD = 'TRDC0006'
AND a.AUC_STATUS_CD IN ('AUCC0005', 'AUCC0006')
AND a.AUC_STATUS_CD = 'AUCC0004'
AND (t.TRD_STATUS_CD = 'TRDC0006' OR a.AUC_STATUS_CD IN ('AUCC0004', 'AUCC0005', 'AUCC0006'))
ORDER BY p.PRD_REG_DT DESC

/* ProductMapper.countMyProductsSummary */ SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.PRD_STATUS_CD = 'PRDC0001' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS draft, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.PRD_STATUS_CD = 'PRDC0002' AND a.AUC_STATUS_CD IN ('AUCC0001', 'AUCC0002') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS active, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.AUC_STATUS_CD = 'AUCC0003' AND t.TRD_SN IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS won, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.TRD_STATUS_CD IN ('TRDC0003', 'TRDC0004', 'TRDC0005') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS trading, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.TRD_STATUS_CD = 'TRDC0006' OR a.AUC_STATUS_CD IN ('AUCC0004', 'AUCC0005', 'AUCC0006') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS closed FROM PRODUCT p LEFT JOIN AUCTION a ON a.PRD_SN = p.PRD_SN LEFT JOIN TRADE t ON t.PRD_SN = p.PRD_SN AND t.TRD_TYPE_CD = 'TRDC0001' WHERE p.USR_SN = #{usrSn} AND p.PRD_USE_YN = 'Y' AND p.PRD_STATUS_CD != 'PRDC0004'
mapper.update: /* ProductMapper.updateProduct */ UPDATE PRODUCT SET CAT_SN = #{catSn}, PRD_NM = #{prdNm}, PRD_CN = #{prdCn}, PRD_STATUS_CD = #{prdStatusCd}, PRD_START_AMT = #{prdStartAmt}, PRD_IBY_AMT = #{prdIbyAmt}, PRD_TRD_METHOD_CD = #{prdTrdMethodCd}, PRD_UPDT_ID = #{prdUpdtId}, PRD_DRAFT_BID_UNIT = #{prdDraftBidUnit}, PRD_DRAFT_START_DT = #{prdDraftStartDt}, PRD_DRAFT_END_DT = #{prdDraftEndDt}, PRD_DRAFT_START_NOW_YN = #{prdDraftStartNowYn}, PRD_DRAFT_POLICY_AGREED_YN = #{prdDraftPolicyAgreedYn} WHERE PRD_SN = #{prdSn} AND USR_SN = #{usrSn} AND PRD_USE_YN = 'Y'
/* ProductMapper.deleteExpiredCancelledProduct */ UPDATE PRODUCT SET PRD_USE_YN = 'N', PRD_STATUS_CD = 'PRDC0004', PRD_UPDT_ID = 'SYSTEM' WHERE PRD_SN = #{prdSn} AND PRD_USE_YN = 'Y'
